confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Gold Coast pricing in July (Australian winter, with school holidays). Restaurant and drink anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies with the Surfers Paradise, Broadbeach and Coolangatta areas and with holiday demand. The FX observation came from a search summary attributed to the RBA page; the RBA table itself was not opened and verified.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Australian coastal resort towns with similar tourism profiles (Sunshine Coast, Cairns), adjusted to Gold Coast pricing. Restaurant and bar prices follow Brisbane and Sydney tourist-area levels. Drink anchors were set from the beer price where direct knowledge was weak.
